```plato

// Spatial Worley (cellular) noise: distances to randomly scattered feature
// points, one per lattice cell. Jitter in [0, 1] moves feature points from
// cell centers (0) to fully random positions (1). Produces cellular,
// crystalline, and cracked patterns; output is non-negative
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Worley_noise).
type WorleyNoise3D
    implements IValue, IScalarField3D
{
    Seed: Integer;
    Frequency: Number;
    Jitter: Number;
    Distance: WorleyDistance;
    Feature: WorleyFeature;
}
```
